steps.en: Run the server container with your LLM API key
steps.zh: 带上你的 LLM API key 跑起服务端容器

steps.en: Point a client at it from your agent
steps.zh: 在你的 agent 里接上客户端

steps.en: After each turn, hand it what happened
steps.zh: 每轮结束后，把发生的事交给它

steps.en: An LLM pass extracts facts, entities and dates, then consolidates them into observations
steps.zh: 用 LLM 抽出事实、实体和时间，再在后台合并成观察

steps.en: Before the next reply, ask it a question
steps.zh: 下一次回复前，向它提问

steps.en: Runs semantic, keyword, graph and time searches in parallel, fuses and reranks them to a token budget
steps.zh: 并行跑语义、关键词、图和时间四路检索，融合重排后按 token 预算截断

value.en: Your agent starts each session with the facts it learned before, without you writing extraction prompts, a vector store and a reranker
value.zh: 你的 agent 每次开场就带着之前学到的事实，而不用自己写抽取 prompt、搭向量库和重排器

README.md Python Embedded: client.retain(bank_id="my-bank", content="Alice works at Google")

README.md Core Concepts: retain uses an LLM to extract facts/temporal data/entities; Observations consolidated in the background; Recall runs semantic/BM25/graph/temporal in parallel, RRF + cross-encoder reranking, trimmed to token limit
